name: "Green and Eco-Friendly Measures" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises”
benefit: Cash Award of ₹2,00,000/- and a Citation.
_eligibility_text:
- The industry should be green and eco-friendly as per the DSTE standards.
- The unit should provide at least 60% of employment to the people of UT of Puducherry of the total employment strength of the industrial units.
